author: TheRealDeadpool
quote: For 13 years we waited for a new gta game. Now we have it but it’s a modern red dead redemption 2 I knew when they made rdr2 that they couldn’t top that and I was right because they had to copy that game to make this one and I will never forgive rockstar for taking 8 years from rdr2 and call it working on gta6 it’s not fair to us as people who enjoyed that game to have it just ignored so that can copy it to gta and call it superior do not waste your money on this game play rdr 2 instead
